info.title: stability/edit-outpaint
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "stability/edit-outpaint", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Comfy Router request for Stability outpaint, in Stability's edit fields sent as a JSON object. Extends `image` by the padding on `left`, `right`, `up` and `down`. At least one of those four must be greater than 0; that requirement is enforced by the translator, not by this schema. Returns one PNG and is billed once per call.

creativity.description: How freely to invent the extended area. Default 0.5.

image.description: A Comfy-signed asset URL of the source image.

left.description: Pixels to add on the left. Default 0. At least one of left, right, up or down must be greater than 0.

negative_prompt.description: Accepted and not applied. The outpaint graph has no negative prompt.

prompt.description: What to paint into the extended area.

right.description: Pixels to add on the right. Default 0.

seed.description: 0 or omitted picks a random seed.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for the Stability image models. The image is generated on Comfy-hosted infrastructure and stored on Comfy storage: `image` is a Comfy-signed URL valid for up to 24 hours, not a Stability URL, so download it before then. If the image cannot be stored, the call answers 502 and is not billed; no other URL is returned.

image.description: Comfy-signed URL of the (first) PNG image, valid for up to 24 hours.

images.description: SDXL only, when more than one image was returned. Every Comfy-signed image URL, in output order, each valid for up to 24 hours.

seed.description: The seed the image was generated with.
